# Issue #41: `slugify` produces double hyphens and trailing hyphens

`slugify("Hello,  World!")` returns `"hello--world-"` but should return `"hello-world"`.
Also `slugify("--a--b--")` should give `"a-b"`.

Please fix `textkit/slug.py`. Do not change the public signature.

arguments.summary: Fixed `slugify` in `textkit/slug.py` by changing the non-alphanumeric regex from `[^a-z0-9]` to `[^a-z0-9]+` (collapsing consecutive separators into a single hyphen) and adding `.strip("-")` to remove leading/trailing hyphens. The public signature is unchanged; both existing tests pass and the issue's examples now yield `"hello-world"` and `"a-b"`.
